featured_reviews.name: Pankaj
featured_reviews.review_text: Compact little cafe near Worli sea face. Popped in on a sunday after my medical check up. The cafe has seating on the upper floor but make sure you watch your step and head. Menu is quite extensive and I chose an acai bowl as a healthier breakfast option along with a cafe latte. The bowl was nice and tasted really good. The coffee was good too and I enjoyed it to the last sip. Cost me around 600 INR and well worth it.

featured_reviews.name: Shalaka Tamankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Toise, and it’s such a cozy, welcoming place. The matcha truly lives up to the hype — as a huge matcha lover, I went there specifically for it, and it did not disappoint at all. It was rich, well-balanced, and absolutely delicious.

The coffee was great too, and the banana bread was heavenly — soft, flavourful, and perfectly done. I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone who enjoys good matcha, coffee, and a warm, relaxed ambience.

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Amazing ambience and such a cute spot to just hang with friends. The vibe is warm, aesthetic, and super inviting. You can easily lose track of time here.

Their coffee menu is incredible, with something for everyone, from beginners to full-on aficionados. We even tried the pour-overs and I loved them. We visited twice during my Mumbai trip and had the citrus tonic, orange latte (my absolute favorite), and the dark chocolate mocha (close second!).

The food deserves a special mention too. So good, with tons of options and all pure vegetarian, which makes it even better. You won’t feel limited at all.

It’s also the kind of place where you can just lounge for hours and get work done, with that comforting coffee aroma in the background keeping you going!

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Biswas
featured_reviews.review_text:
Such a cute café with a really calm and aesthetic vibe. The coffee was rich and smooth, and everything felt fresh. Service was quick and polite too. Highly recommend if you like peaceful cafés!
(Bonus- Coffee is roasted in house...so some days you might even see the coffee roasting from upstairs)

featured_reviews.name: Shadaab Kadri
featured_reviews.review_text:
Found this spot by accident and it turned out to be such a great place to sit and relax with your coffee. I had the banana smoothie bowl, the truffle mushroom pie and a cortado and everything was 🤌
The staff were also super friendly. Sonu was very kind and helpful.

featured_reviews.name: A A
featured_reviews.review_text:
A well rounded experience that goes beyond just good food and coffee. In addition to serving quality beverages and fresh food, the cafe also provides bikes on rent. We had an excellent time renting bikes and riding along the promenade. Post the ride, we returned to the cafe for some coffee and a croissant, both of which met expectations in terms of quality and taste.
A great experience altogether, thanks to the staff.

featured_reviews.name: Krish Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited this place and ordered a dark chocolate mocha and an iced pour-over. Unfortunately, we didn’t like the taste of the dark chocolate mocha, so we politely went back and asked if it could be modified.

They added more dark chocolate, but it made the drink even worse. When we requested a replacement, the staff refused outright.

To make matters worse, when we asked for water, we were told to go upstairs and get it ourselves. The staff member, Nagrag, was extremely rude and dismissive throughout.

On top of that, a 5% service charge was added to the bill, which felt completely unjustified given the level of service.

Very disappointing experience overall, both in terms of product and basic hospitality.

featured_reviews.name: Ayush Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great cafe run by great people. I just loved my Oat-Milk Cold Coffee. Rarely do I find people getting it this right. Would definitely recommend this  place.

I spilled my drink and they were super-sweet to replace it with a fresh one at no extra charge. Thank you so much!!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Javaphile, Worli and honestly loved the experience.
The place is very cute, clean and super aesthetic.
I tried the salted caramel cold coffee and strawberry matcha – both were really good.
The raspberry French toast was soft and perfectly balanced.
The chipotle chicken wrap and smoked salmon tartini were fresh and filling.
Their vegan dark chocolate cake is a must try.
The vibe is calm and perfect to sit and chill.
Definitely a great new café in South Bombay and I would love to visit again.

featured_reviews.name: Mina Blogs
featured_reviews.review_text: This newly opened place in worli is a heaven for coffee lovers. It's cosy and cute place with amazing coffee. I had their cappuccino which was really good. One of the best cappuccino I ever had. I had their avocado super toast and garlic turkish eggs which were very delicious. I also had their Mediterranean chicken sandwich which was yummy. In dessert would recommend you to try vegan chocolate cake which is a must try for chocolate lovers.

featured_reviews.name: Mansee Nisar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Let me share a honest review. I wasn't expecting anything great apart from coffee or drinks but the food here is excellent which i couldn't not imagine, too good . We ordered veg food and it was too good , Mexican fajita bowl ,pesto grill, chickpea wrap,avocado toast
loved the java chip frappe and tropical mango cloud . Would definitely come here again with friends.

featured_reviews.name: Saloni Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved my visit to Javaphile! The place has such a warm and cozy vibe — perfect for catching up or just relaxing. Tried the Asian peanut tofu bowl and peri peri paneer wrap, both were packed with flavour and really satisfying. The cottage cheese pesto sandwich was fresh and delicious too.
Their drinks are a highlight — the hot chocolate was rich and comforting, and the tropical mango matcha was super refreshing. Ended with their dark chocolate cookie and croissant, which was the perfect sweet touch.
Great food, great ambience, and good service. Definitely a spot I’ll keep coming back to!

featured_reviews.name: Rohan Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
We stopped by Javaphile, and every bite felt like comfort on a plate.

Starting with a refreshing Japanese Matcha Ice Latte and the rich, indulgent Iced Sea Salt Mocha.

For food, the Peri Peri Paneer Wrap packed a spicy punch, while the Guacamole & Cream Cheese Tartine was fresh, creamy, and absolutely delicious.

The Asian Peanut Bowl brought together bold flavors and wholesome goodness in every bite.

Their classic Tiramisu a perfect dessert.

If you’re a café lover, Javaphile deserves a spot on your must-visit list. 🍵🤎

featured_reviews.name: Prachiti Gadekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re looking for a cozy café with aesthetic vibes and genuinely good food, Javaphile Cafe is a lovely pick 💫

The ambience is minimal yet warm—perfect for a chill catch-up or even a solo coffee date.

Coming to the food, their beverages truly stand out. The signature hot chocolate was rich, smooth, and comforting, while the vanilla coffee frappe hit the right balance of sweetness and coffee—both absolutely perfect.

For quick bites, the chicken chipotle wrap is a must-try—especially with its unique beetroot tortilla that adds both color and flavor. The Mediterranean chicken sandwich was fresh and satisfying, but the highlight for me was the Asian peanut bowl with grilled chicken. The combination of noodles, creamy peanut sauce, and perfectly grilled chicken was just spot on.

Ended the meal with a vegan chocolate cake, and honestly, it was the perfect finish—rich, indulgent, and didn’t feel “vegan” at all.

Overall, a great place for good coffee, wholesome bites, and a relaxing vibe. Definitely coming back! ✨

featured_reviews.name: Ria Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
Javaphile Café in Worli is such a refreshing spot for coffee lovers. The space has a warm, cozy and premium feel without being too formal. Perfect for coffee, casual meetings.
Service is bit slow but its a
A great neighbourhood café that fits perfectly into Worli’s vibe.

featured_reviews.name: Binu
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located within a short walk from the Worli Sea Face Promenade is this cute cozy cafe which has aesthetic vibes and serves a variety of specialty coffees and healthy food options like wraps ,bowls and healthy sandwiches.

Tried the Avocado Super Toast which was fresh and creamy .The Peri Peri Paneer Wrap was well - balanced and flavourful .The Cottage Cheese Pesto Grilled Sandwich was delicious.The Mexican Fajita bowl with brown rice, smoky fajita paneer and zesty corn salsa with guac and sour cream was hearty & wholesome.

We tried the javachip frappe and hot chocolate both of which are a must try.

Their vegan chocolate cake was rich and moist —a must try for chocolate lovers.

A great place for chill catch ups and great coffee with wholesome food.

featured_reviews.review_text: This place is nestled in a busy street of Worli towards the road that leads to sea-link. I visited this during the rainy season in September for a catchup with friend. Sandwiches and coffee variety is great. The staff is quite prompt with service. They also have a mezzanine floor which can accommodate a bigger group. featured_reviews.name: C
featured_reviews.review_text: So the place has a very nice atmosphere and vibe. It's possible we visited at a bad time since it was really crowded. My orders took forever to come. Half an hour after my order i was told the dish I ordered was not available. This was simply unacceptable. I'm quite sure the staff forgot my order at one point and had to be reminded. featured_reviews.review_text: Matcha was very average. Only color no flavor. Food was great and good for a quick bite. Busy though

featured_reviews.name: Hamza Husein
featured_reviews.review_text:
Location is close by the Worli Promenade, good location to get a cup of coffee and a bite to eat. I had a dark roast cappuccino (you can ask for different beans!) and a PB&J cookie (recommended by the staff). Overall both were great, the cookie a bit messy to eat.

There is both indoor and outdoor seating, but I would not recommend sitting outside due to other patron's cigarette smoke and dust from the road.

A good place to chill, catchup or get some work done.

PS: They have a pretty neat music playlist playing in the background!

featured_reviews.name: SHARAN SUREKA
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Stand By Coffee, Worli on a Sunday after a lovely walk at the Coastal Road promenade, but the experience completely spoiled the mood. The café was in a rush hour, which we understood, but the service was extremely slow and unorganized. We ordered a green tea and a toast and sat right in front of the counter. Even after repeatedly reminding the counter boy and the chef—who were right in front of us—nothing was prepared on time. The toast came after 25 minutes, and the green tea arrived 20 minutes later, only when we got frustrated and asked them to either make it immediately or refund us. By then, the toast had already gone cold.

Another disappointing part was that while placing the order, they didn’t inform us that service charge would be added. Only after paying did we notice it on the bill. We didn’t say anything at that moment because who wants to run back for a small amount while trying to enjoy the day—but the experience that followed made it feel unfair.

When we finally gave our feedback, the staff (possibly the owner) responded casually with just a “thanks for the feedback” and showed no concern. Because of the poor service and attitude, we asked them to remove the ₹30 service charge—not for the amount, but because the service truly didn’t justify it.

I don’t recommend visiting this café on Sundays, and based on this experience, I’m unsure about other days too. This visit really ruined what could have been a great end to a beautiful walk.

I am a regular customer at Chaayos, VIOS Tower, and visit almost every day for tea. Unfortunately, my experience with two staff members, Swastika and Kajal, has been consistently disappointing.
Despite being regular customers, we are often met with rude and arrogant behavior. They rarely respond politely, never greet customers with a smile, and seem unwilling to provide basic customer service. We kept hoping that things would improve with subsequent visits, but the attitude remains the same regardless of the time of day.
Good customer service is about being courteous and respectful, especially towards loyal customers. The lack of professionalism and hospitality displayed by these staff members significantly affects the overall experience at an otherwise great outlet.
I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and addresses the issue to ensure a better customer experience.

featured_reviews.name: Manish
featured_reviews.review_text:
Chaayos has become a popular spot for tea lovers in India, and for good reason. They've taken the classic chai experience and given it a modern twist, with a wide variety of options to choose from. Whether you're a fan of the traditional "cutting chai" or you're feeling adventurous and want to try something new like their "Aam Papad Chai," there's something for everyone.

What I appreciate most about Chaayos is the atmosphere. It's a great place to catch up with friends, have a casual meeting, or just relax with a good book. The décor is usually cozy and inviting, with comfortable seating and a laid-back vibe.
Beyond the chai, Chaayos also offers a decent selection of snacks and light bites. Their "Bun Maska" is a must-try, and they also have other options like samosas, sandwiches, and more. It's the perfect place to grab a quick and satisfying meal or snack to go with your chai.
While the prices might be a bit higher than your average tea stall, the quality of the tea and the overall experience make it worth it. Chaayos is a great place to indulge in your love for chai and enjoy a relaxed atmosphere.

Pros:
* Wide variety of chai options
* Cozy and inviting atmosphere
* Delicious snacks and light bites
* Great for casual gatherings

Cons:
* Prices can be a bit higher than average

Overall:
Chaayos is a must-visit for any chai lover. They've successfully created a modern and enjoyable chai experience that's perfect for any occasion.
Would I recommend it? Yes, definitely!

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely unacceptable customer service experience. We were made to stand at the counter for over five minutes with no communication whatsoever—no information, no apology, not even a polite acknowledgment that cleaning work was in progress and that there would be a delay. I specifically wish to name Sakhya for her outright rude and dismissive behavior during this time. People were waiting and lining up—busy office-goers and working professionals—simply trying to get a cup of tea or place a basic order. After waiting, when we finally asked to place our order, we were casually informed by Sakhya that what we wanted was unavailable. The entire interaction reflected a complete lack of basic courtesy, professionalism, and respect for customers—people who were quite literally standing right in front of the counter being ignored. featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a wonderful experience at Third Wave Café, a place that effortlessly balances great beverages, delicious food, and an inviting atmosphere. For our drinks, we ordered the Sea Salt Mocha and the Toffee Nut Latte—both cold beverages turned out to be exceptional choices. The sea salt mocha had that perfect sweet-salty harmony, while the toffee nut latte was smooth, indulgent, and incredibly satisfying. Third Wave really knows how to elevate a coffee experience.
We also tried their Chilly Cheese Garlic Toast, which was outstanding. Crispy, cheesy, and packed with flavour, it paired beautifully with the tasty dip served alongside. It’s the kind of comforting yet exciting café snack you instantly want to reorder.
What truly made the visit memorable was the overall vibe. We spent our evening casually playing a card game of Word It, and the café felt like the perfect place for it. Third Wave has this rare ability to blend multiple moods—whether you want to chill, work, chat, or play, it feels just right. The ambience is warm, relaxed, and thoughtfully designed to make you stay longer than you planned.
A genuinely lovely café experience that we’d happily revisit again and again.

The cappuccino had a perfect balance of flavors, with a rich espresso shot and velvety steamed milk. The cold coffee was refreshing and smooth, made to perfection. The quality of the coffee is top-notch, and it's clear that the baristas take pride in their craft.
A big thank you to the team for bringing Third Wave Coffee to Worli! The staff were friendly, welcoming, and attentive, making our experience even more enjoyable. We're thrilled to have this wonderful coffee shop in our neighborhood, and we can't wait to come back and try more of their offerings. If you're a coffee lover, do give Third Wave Coffee a try – you won't be disappointed

Now coming to the food, which is the other big reason I keep returning. It never disappoints. Honestly, you could close your eyes, point at anything on the menu, and you will still end up with something delicious. Every dish is consistently well made and full of flavour.

featured_reviews.name: Vishwesh Ranadive
featured_reviews.review_text:
Cafe Trofima, Shivaji Park, Dadar, Mumbai

Cafe Trofima, located near the bustling Shivaji Park in Dadar, has garnered attention as a popular hangout spot, but it falls short of the hype for several reasons.

Food

The menu boasts a variety of food options, including breakfast platters, which might initially seem impressive. However, the taste of the food is compromised and does not justify the high prices. For a cafe that markets itself as a premium experience, the quality of the dishes leaves much to be desired.

Ambience and Seating

The sitting space is one of the better aspects of Cafe Trofima. Considering it is a cafe, the seating is comfortable and suitable for casual conversations or work. However, the overall ambience is just average, with no music to elevate the vibe. It lacks the warmth or charm that many would expect from a cafe in this area.

Service

The service is satisfactory but nothing extraordinary. While the staff is polite and attends to customers in a timely manner, the overall experience doesn’t stand out as memorable.

Location and Accessibility

A significant downside is the lack of parking space, which can be a hassle, especially given the busy location of Shivaji Park. Visitors arriving in their own vehicles may find it inconvenient.

Pricing

The prices are on the higher side, making it hard to justify for the quality of food and overall experience provided. While there are plenty of food options to choose from, the value for money is not reflected in the offerings.

Verdict

Cafe Trofima is overrated and doesn’t quite live up to its reputation. While it has some redeeming qualities like decent seating and satisfactory service, the compromised food taste, lack of parking, and high prices make it hard to recommend wholeheartedly. It could work as a one-time visit for those curious about its breakfast platters, but better options are available in and around the area for a more satisfying experience.

Overall Rating: 2/5

featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited Nude Food Café as a group of five and, unfortunately, the experience didn’t go as well as we hoped. Although we were told the wait would be around 20 minutes, we ended up waiting 1.5 hours for a table, while others seemed to be seated much faster. The staff and owners were polite, but the communication about wait times needs improvement, and there were no proper waiting arrangements.

On the positive side, the café has a great eco-friendly concept with a zero-waste food policy, which I really appreciate. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, even though the space feels a bit small and crowded.

The coffee was excellent, the chicken pie was tasty (could’ve used a spicy note), and the pasta dishes were nice, though one was slightly undercooked and could have used more spice. Portions felt a bit small for the price.

Overall, while the café’s concept and ambience are lovely, the extremely slow service and long wait time took away from the experience. Expanding the seating area or managing reservations more clearly would help a lot.

featured_reviews.name: Betterwithbffs
featured_reviews.review_text: We recently visited this newly opened cafe @iteeha.coffee store in Mahalaxmi. This place has an amazing soothing ambience and I’m totally in love with it. Not only the ambience is comforting but the food is so good that you’ll be wanting more. We tried their Mac & Cheese which was exactly perfect for the quote don’t judge a book by its cover😂 It looked a little sad but honestly it’s one of the best mac & cheese I’ve ever tasted. The second was the Ham and Cheese sandwich, this is the dish that stuck in my mind. It’s super yummy and even after a few days of visit I’m still craving for more. The next was Butter croissant, it was flaky, crispy and loaded with butter. Chicken Quiche was our next choice. The pastry was perfectly golden and crispy and it’s definitely a good one. For beverages, we tried their House cold coffee with Vanilla bean ice cream, it’s definitely a must try for all those who love thick coffee shake. We even tried their Mocha which was also amazing. The staff even managed to convince us to try their new Orange Chilli Hot Chocolate which was something I was hesitant but honestly it was so good. The hot chocolate had the perfect orange zest and chilli spice. Everything was so well balanced. For the desserts we had their New York Cheesecake and it’s definitely one of the best I’ve had yet. In all it’s just a place you’d want to spend an evening at with relaxing ambience and good food. The staff was amazing making our meal perfect.

featured_reviews.name: Tanishka Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
My recent visit at this cafe totally has my heart. With great food and service this place is just a spot to relax. The vibe of this place is so peaceful and the ambience is just great. With a great subtle decor this place is absolutely gorgeous. Every corner of this cafe is Instagram worthy. We were served by Lloyd and Sashikant. They both were attentive and the service was quick. They even made sure every table and every part of the cafe is maintained clean.
Few items mentioned below are which I gave a try and would recommend it to all.
• Affogato Vanilla Coffee :- Basically it's an Italian dessert with a scoop of vanilla ice cream over which an espresso is poured. This combination is absolutely amazing and is enjoyed by every coffee lover. You either sip on it or have it with a spoon. The taste is strong and would definitely recommend it to everyone.
• Vietnamese Cold Brew :- This coffee is made using sweetened condensed milk instead of milk, sugar or any sweetner. This does taste very different and is something which you need to give it a try.
• Veg Quiche:- Quiche is basically a custard baked in a flaky pie crust shell. It's stuffed with various options and is enjoyed by every one. Here we tried is the veg quiche which had cheese and leek.
• Chicken Quiche :- Similar to the up one, only difference is it has chicken stuffing.
• Ham & Cheese Sandwich:- This one absolutely had my heart. Super super delicious crisp sandwich. The classic sandwich which never fails to amaze you.
• Classic Chicken Sandwich :- Great great filling absolutely different than we usually get and would anyday go for this one. Chicken lovers, this crisp amazing delicious Sandwich is worth a try.
• Chocolate Cake :- One of the best chocolate cakes I have had. Soft, melting in mouth this cake has my heart.
